snippet.title: Dino Bros - Standalone Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for Dino Bros Standalone release, out now on Google Play and Appstore!

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.martinmagni.dinobros&hl=sv
Appstore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dino-bros/id6677035359

Play the game at: https://poki.com/se/g/longcat

Help the two dino bros collect all coins on each map by working together! Easy to understand, difficult to master.

- Playable offline
- One-time purchase to remove ads
- 100 hand-made levels
